problems: Table uses two "Projected Real Estate Taxes" scenarios for first and second year of condominium operations (not a tax-exempt vs non-exempt scenario); I placed first-year monthly/annual in tax_m/tax_a and second-year monthly in tax2_m per template convention, but second-year annual (16532.77/15992.04/14495.38) is not captured in any template column.

"Uninhabitable Area" column contains multiple sub-figures per unit (e.g. "c. 872 a. 202 p. 198 ry. 825" = cellar/areaway/porch/rear yard sq ft); only the first (cellar, used as sf2) is captured numerically; full breakdown placed in note.

No "ext_sf" (terrace/balcony/yard single figure) column exists in this table; left as "-" for all units since outdoor areas are part of the combined uninhabitable-area breakdown, not a standalone column.

Also no "Rooms" or "Floor" numeric column, and beds/bathrooms given as combined code (e.g. "1/2full3half") which is ambiguous — recorded as-is in beds/baths columns is not possible per template rules (not clearly "beds/baths" format); for Unit 1 "1/2full3half" left as note/unclear, beds/baths left "-".

"No. of Bedrooms/Bathrooms" format for units 2 and 3 ("3/2" and "4/2.5") interpreted as beds/baths per template examples; Unit 1's code "1/2full3half" does not fit that pattern and was left blank with note.

Projected Monthly Carrying Charges has two values (first year/second year); per template I used first-year carrying charge as carry_m; second-year carrying charge (1392.11/1346.58/1220.56 — note these numbers match second-year tax_m, verify against page) is not captured.

Total row's price total is $500,000.00 and pct total 100.00%, but individual unit prices for Units 1 and 2 are "Not for sale"/"Not for Sale" (non-numeric) — total figure in TOTAL line reflects only Unit 3's price.
